g.text: Keys are means over each action span after key normalization and before RoPE; A is not a per-token distance.
Gray B cells: zero fitted shift, so the strict-sign fraction has no directional interpretation. Read still shows zero response.
All layer / KV-head cells are shown. Black outlines: 4 heads accepted by selection screens.
